setupAddins.name: Clarion Assistant
setupAddins.description: AI-powered assistant for the Clarion IDE: embedded Claude Code terminal, MCP tools, LSP integration, CodeGraph and DocGraph code intelligence, and IDE automation. Requires the Microsoft WebView2 runtime and a Claude account - the embedded Claude Code CLI transmits the prompts and source you give it to Anthropic's API. Ships as a Windows installer covering Clarion 10, 11, 11.1 and 12.
setupAddins.author: ClarionLive

setupAddins.name: CA Debugger
setupAddins.description: Standalone debugger for the Clarion IDE: native gutter breakpoints, stepping, call stack with procedure names, and watch-by-name over the TSWD debug engine. Installs independently - no Clarion Assistant required. Requires the Microsoft WebView2 runtime. Ships as a Windows installer covering Clarion 10, 11 and 12.
setupAddins.author: ClarionLive
